final: WITH filtered_scans AS (SELECT s.questregistry, s.zoneref, s.gbsize, s.spanmin, si.healtheval FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), group_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, healtheval, AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0 THEN gbsize / CAST(spanmin AS REAL) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM filtered_scans GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval), all_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_avg FROM group_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.healtheval, gs.avg_ratio, gs.scan_count, gs.avg_ratio - aa.mean_avg as excess FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN all_avg aa WHERE aa.mean_avg IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio > aa.mean_avg) SELECT zoneref, healtheval, avg_ratio, scan_count, excess FROM filtered_groups ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
